value.rationale: The filter was recently motivated for step-size-independent energy stability; a sharp four-vertex physically natural graph counterexample and exact positivity cutoff demonstrate that this guarantee is independent of positivity of nodal heat states. The general fixed-order L+ mechanism predicts negative entries at stiff steps even when every spectral multiplier is between one half and one. This informs when maximum-principle safeguards are necessary; it is not merely code verification or a small isolated numerical observation.
